t2.thesis: Zillow enters the print after a sharp run-up in housing stocks on falling yields, with a large implied move and a recent history of negative post-earnings opens despite beats, so the edge over the buy-everything base rate is roughly nil.
reasons: Last 4 prints: only 1 of 4 positive open-to-open reactions, and the last two fell 6-15% despite ~15% EPS beats, which suggests a high bar
Stock rallied about 8% on 11/2 and is up 13% over 1 month on falling Treasury yields, so good news looks partly priced in before the print
Implied move of about 14% with ATM IV at 1.37x realized vol is expensive, so there is no cheap-optionality edge for longs
Offsetting: 18% revenue growth, a guide reaffirmed in August, a 7% headcount cut, buybacks, and a low forward P/E of 11 sit on a stock down about 59% from its high
EPS estimates were cut 12.5% over 90 days, which lowers the bar, and short interest of 9.3% gives squeeze potential on a beat
t2.deciding_variable: Q4 guidance, particularly revenue and EBITDA outlook against a slower second-half housing market, and traffic trends.

theses.expected: Stock falls at the next open
theses.mechanism: After the run-up on falling yields, a guide that merely meets expectations or soft traffic (-2% y/y) triggers selling, as in the last two prints.
theses.wrong_if: Q4 revenue and EBITDA guidance beats the high end and traffic stabilizes.

theses.expected: Stock rises at the next open
theses.mechanism: Lowered estimates, cost cuts, mortgage growth of 75%, and short interest set up a squeeze on a beat with a solid guide.
theses.wrong_if: The guide implies a decelerating second half or margins disappoint.

theses.expected: Stock is flat to modestly moved, with direction set by the macro open
theses.mechanism: Rates and housing sentiment dominate and offset the company-specific news.
theses.wrong_if: The move exceeds 10% in either direction on company-specific news.

Traffic and unique user trend, and Residential revenue growth
